newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 ends lower on profit-taking, switching.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 ends lower on profit-taking, switching.

text.p: British shares ended mixed on Friday as investors took profits in blue chips after this week's record-setting rally and funneled those profits into mid-caps, which have lagged far behind the key FTSE 100 so far this year.
The benchmark FTSE 100 ended 55.5 points lower at 5,031.3, having soared into uncharted territory during the previous two days.
Yet the FTSE 250 mid-cap index, which had underperformed the FTSE 100 index by some 18 percent so far this year, added 52.3 points, or 1.1 percent, to close at 4,650.5.
